knowledge:
- key_parameters: rt_tolerance=In mergeMS2spectra(), controls the retention time window (in seconds) for merging redundant spectra. Set very low (e.g., 1s) for DI-MS/MS to only merge consecutive scans, or higher (e.g., 60s) for LC-MS/MS. ;; mz_tolerance=In mergeMS2spectra() and distanceMatrix(), controls the mass accuracy tolerance. Use small values (e.g., 10ppm or 3e-5) for high-resolution data, and larger values (e.g., 0.02 Da) for low-resolution instruments. ;; min_peaks=In extractPseudospectra(), specifies the minimum number of peaks required to extract a pseudospectrum. ;; min_similarity=In networkplot(), sets the minimum spectral similarity threshold for displaying edges in correlation networks (default is 0.1, but 0.4 is recommended for low-resolution data to reduce noise). ;; h=In HCplot(), defines the height threshold for cutting dendrograms to color-code clusters. ;; tolerance=In findFragment(), specifies the relative mass tolerance for finding specific fragment ions (e.g., 0.5/315 for unit mass resolution around m/z 315).
- alternatives: CAMERA=Used in conjunction with metaMS for GC-EI-MS data preprocessing to generate xsAnnotate objects, which are then passed to CluMSID's extractPseudospectra() instead of using standard MS2 extraction. ;; metaMS=Used for GC-EI-MS peak picking and running CAMERA (via runCAMERA()) because standard xcms/CAMERA workflows can struggle with GC-EI-MS data. ;; MetaboliteDetector=An external program mentioned for GC-EI-MS feature annotation, whose outputs can be imported into CluMSID using writeFeaturelist() and addAnnotations().
- when_to_use: Use CluMSID when you want to explore chemodiversity, group structurally related metabolites, or facilitate feature annotation in metabolomics datasets (LC-MS/MS, DI-MS/MS, or GC-EI-MS) by clustering similar mass spectra.
- pitfalls: Merging DI-MS/MS spectra with a large rt_tolerance (e.g., 250s) risks merging spectra from different but structurally similar analytes. ;; Low-resolution data (GC-EI-MS or low-res LC-MS/MS) has high between-cluster similarities because fragments with different chemical compositions but the same unit resolution mass cannot be distinguished, leading to "warmer" heatmaps and chaotic network plots if default thresholds are used. ;; High-resolution methods should always be favored over low-resolution methods for feature annotation due to mass accuracy benefits.

workflows.name: di_ms2_highres
workflows.intent: Extract, merge, and cluster MS2 spectra from high-resolution Direct Infusion (DI-MS/MS) data.
workflows.stages: 1. Extract MS2 spectra using extractMS2spectra() ;; 2. Merge redundant spectra with a tight retention time tolerance using mergeMS2spectra() ;; 3. Generate a spectral similarity distance matrix using distanceMatrix() ;; 4. Visualize similarities with a circularized dendrogram using HCplot()
workflows.code:
ms2list <- extractMS2spectra (DIfile)
featlist <- mergeMS2spectra (ms2list, rt_tolerance = 1 )
distmat <- distanceMatrix (featlist)
HCplot (distmat, cex = 0.5 )

workflows.name: gc_ei_ms_lowres
workflows.intent: Extract, annotate, and cluster MS1 pseudospectra from low-resolution GC-EI-MS data using CAMERA and metaMS.
workflows.stages: 1. Run peak picking and CAMERA annotation using metaMS::runCAMERA() ;; 2. Extract pseudospectra using extractPseudospectra() ;; 3. Export feature list for manual annotation using writeFeaturelist() ;; 4. Plot individual pseudospectra using specplot() ;; 5. Add external annotations using addAnnotations() ;; 6. Generate a distance matrix with low-resolution mass tolerance using distanceMatrix() ;; 7. Visualize similarities using heatmaps, dendrograms, and correlation networks using HCplot() and networkplot() ;; 8. Search for specific diagnostic fragment ions using findFragment()
workflows.code:
xA <- metaMS :: runCAMERA (xcms :: xcmsSet (pool), chrom = "GC" , settings = metaMS :: metaSetting (TSQXLS.GC, "CAMERA" ))
pslist <- extractPseudospectra (xA, min_peaks = 0 )
writeFeaturelist (pslist, "GC_pre.csv" )
specplot (pslist[[ 27 ]])
apslist <- addAnnotations ( featlist = pslist, annolist = system.file ( "extdata" , "GC_post.csv" , package = "CluMSIDdata" ))
pseudodistmat <- distanceMatrix (apslist, mz_tolerance = 0.02 )
HCplot (pseudodistmat, type = "heatmap" , cexRow = 0.4 , cexCol = 0.4 , margins = c ( 7 , 7 ))
networkplot (pseudodistmat, highlight_annotated = TRUE , show_labels = TRUE , exclude_singletons = TRUE )
networkplot (pseudodistmat, highlight_annotated = TRUE , show_labels = TRUE , exclude_singletons = TRUE , min_similarity = 0.4 )
HCplot (pseudodistmat, h = 0.7 , cex = 0.5 )
fragmentlist <- findFragment (apslist, mz = 315 , tolerance = 0.5 / 315 )
vapply ( X = fragmentlist, FUN = accessID, FUN.VALUE = integer ( 1 ))

workflows.name: lc_ms2_lowres
workflows.intent: Extract, merge, and cluster MS2 spectra from low-resolution LC-MS/MS data.
workflows.stages: 1. Extract MS2 spectra using extractMS2spectra() ;; 2. Merge redundant spectra with a low-resolution mass tolerance using mergeMS2spectra() ;; 3. Generate a distance matrix using distanceMatrix() ;; 4. Visualize similarities using multidimensional scaling (MDSplot), heatmaps, and dendrograms (HCplot)
workflows.code:
ms2list <- extractMS2spectra (lowresfile)
featlist <- mergeMS2spectra (ms2list, mz_tolerance = 0.02 )
distmat <- distanceMatrix (featlist)
MDSplot (distmat)
HCplot (distmat, type = "heatmap" , cexRow = 0.1 , cexCol = 0.1 , margins = c ( 6 , 6 ))
HCplot (distmat, h = 0.8 , cex = 0.3 )

workflows.name: lc_ms2_multi_file_external_peaks
workflows.intent: Extract MS2 spectra from multiple raw files, merge them using an external peak list, add annotations, and cluster them.
workflows.stages: 1. Extract MS2 spectra from multiple files using extractMS2spectra() and combine them ;; 2. Format the external peak table to match CluMSID requirements ;; 3. Merge spectra matching the external peak table using mergeMS2spectra() ;; 4. Add external annotations using addAnnotations() ;; 5. Generate a distance matrix using distanceMatrix() ;; 6. Visualize similarities using HCplot() and plot individual annotated spectra using specplot() and getSpectrum()
workflows.code:
YH1list <- extractMS2spectra (YH1)
AX1list <- extractMS2spectra (AX1)
LP1list <- extractMS2spectra (LP1)
BR1list <- extractMS2spectra (BR1)
raw_oillist <- c (YH1list, AX1list, LP1list, BR1list)
mtbls_df <- readr :: read_delim (raw_mtbls_df, " \t " ) %>% dplyr :: mutate ( metabolite_identification = stringr :: str_replace (metabolite_identification, "unknown" , "" )) %>% dplyr :: mutate ( id = paste0 ( "M" , mass_to_charge, "T" , retention_time)) %>% dplyr :: mutate ( retention_time = retention_time * 60 ) %>% dplyr :: select (id, mass_to_charge, retention_time, metabolite_identification) %>% dplyr :: rename ( mz = mass_to_charge, rt = retention_time, annotation = metabolite_identification)
oillist <- mergeMS2spectra (raw_oillist, peaktable = mtbls_df[, 1 : 3 ], exclude_unmatched = TRUE , rt_tolerance = 60 , mz_tolerance = 3e-5 )
fl <- featureList (oillist)
fl_annos <- dplyr :: left_join (fl, mtbls_df, by = "id" )
annolist <- addAnnotations (oillist, fl_annos, annotationColumn = 6 )
distmat <- distanceMatrix (annolist, mz_tolerance = 3e-5 )
HCplot (distmat, h = 0.7 , cex = 0.7 )
specplot ( getSpectrum (annolist, "annotation" , "Stearic acid" ))
specplot ( getSpectrum (annolist, "annotation" , "Arachidic acid" ))
